owner_role: decision authority for genuine project intent and consequential normative choices
system_role: preserve appropriate evidence and continuation state
observe control-plane failures and architecture-evolution triggers
design_boundary.principle: The owner should not need to remember the architecture in order to use the architecture.

control_responsibilities.name: Project-event interpretation and explicit-intent boundary
must_do: Distinguish ordinary question/discussion from observation, investigation request, change request, preservation request, resume request, operational incident, architecture challenge, review result, and other consequential project events.
Preserve explicit owner directives and overrides.
Expose uncertainty when event classification materially affects downstream routing.
must_not_do: Treat every utterance as a mutation request.
Require command syntax for normal operation.
Let model confidence silently authorize consequential behavior.

control_responsibilities.name: Reconstruction and knowledge-activation closure
must_do: Choose task-shaped reconstruction rather than whole-corpus loading.
Activate mandatory governing/risk-bearing/deferred knowledge when event conditions intersect it.
Keep exploratory retrieval subordinate to project-controlled mandatory closure.
Produce an inspectable traversal/activation receipt appropriate to consequence.
must_not_do: Depend on owner filename knowledge.
Assume search similarity equals authority or mandatory relevance.
Declare success merely because relevant knowledge was discoverable after an explicit hint.

control_responsibilities.name: Authority, action-contract, and conformance gate
must_do: Resolve task-relevant governing authority before consequential guidance/action.
Bind exact revisions/freshness/private dependencies where required.
Activate mandatory action constraints and verify proposed guidance/action preserves them.
Fail visibly when required authority or conformance cannot be established.
must_not_do: Allow retrieval rank, recency, model confidence, or convenience to set authority.
Treat source reading alone as proof that final guidance conforms.

control_responsibilities.name: Process, workstream, recovery, and Git-lifecycle routing
must_do: Select the appropriate project process and workstream transition.
Preserve parent/child/return semantics across interruptions and side missions.
Route operational failures to recovery paths independent of the failed component.
Apply governed branch/publication lifecycle policy when Git state is part of the work.
must_not_do: Consume the main workstream indefinitely with an unrelated recovery incident.
Infer completion from previous-chat plans rather than durable evidence.
Conflate current branch state with lifecycle policy.

control_responsibilities.name: Collaboration and tool routing
must_do: Choose SOLO, review, independent/comparative, adversarial, implementation, or local-evidence collaboration according to task characteristics.
Keep collaboration policy distinct from transport.
Respect capability availability, independence requirements, write ownership, and review gates.
Allow manual relay when it is the accepted transport without making the owner decide the collaboration topology.
must_not_do: Use more models by default.
Treat a provider/model as project authority.
Require automatic Codex dispatch, wakeup, or multi-agent machinery when manual transport satisfies the accepted workflow.

control_responsibilities.name: Preservation, promotion, and interaction continuity
must_do: Distinguish ephemeral conversation, interaction-durable non-authoritative continuity, captured candidate understanding, and promoted project knowledge.
Preserve unresolved interaction-local material when interruption would otherwise lose important reasoning.
Route valuable new understanding into capture/backlog/research/current-owner update as appropriate.
Never auto-promote conversation into authority.
must_not_do: Store every token forever.
Lose important unresolved reasoning merely because it is not yet canonical.
Turn session metadata into substantive project authority.

control_responsibilities.name: Self-observation, obligation closure, and architecture evolution
must_do: Observe activation/routing/conformance/preservation misses and recurring pressure.
Track accepted design obligations through implementation gate, implementation evidence, and operational activation.
Distinguish implementation defects from clarification, amendment, supersession, and architecture reopen.
Activate known reopen conditions without making the trigger itself an automatic architecture change.
must_not_do: Rely on the owner to notice every repeated system failure.
Silently drift away from frozen architecture.
Retroactively rewrite historical acceptance gates when a prospective scheduling gap is discovered.

control_responsibilities.name: Successor bridge and authority-transition safety
must_do: Allow successor control behavior to be evaluated/operated without claiming successor semantic authority.
Use current continuity architecture as authoritative input until explicit later switch.
Keep mutation authority bounded and case-specific.
Make rollback/fallback and degraded-mode behavior explicit.
must_not_do: Use control-plane activation as an implicit authority switch.
Let successor-generated interpretations overwrite live authority merely because routing is better.

failure_taxonomy.name: EVENT_MISCLASSIFICATION
failure_taxonomy.definition: Owner/project event is classified into a materially wrong process class.

failure_taxonomy.name: ACTIVATION_MISS
failure_taxonomy.definition: Relevant mandatory governing/risk-bearing knowledge exists but does not enter reasoning when the event makes it applicable.

failure_taxonomy.name: ACTIVATION_OVERREACH
failure_taxonomy.definition: Irrelevant or excessive context is made mandatory and degrades task fidelity or reconstruction cost.

failure_taxonomy.name: AUTHORITY_BYPASS
failure_taxonomy.definition: Consequential guidance/action proceeds without required authority resolution/consumption.

failure_taxonomy.name: CONTRACT_FIDELITY_LOSS
failure_taxonomy.definition: Correct governing source is activated but material constraints/order/prohibitions do not survive into final guidance/action.

failure_taxonomy.name: PROCESS_MISROUTE
failure_taxonomy.definition: Correct event is sent to the wrong project lifecycle or procedure.

failure_taxonomy.name: COLLABORATION_MISROUTE
failure_taxonomy.definition: Collaboration topology/model/tool choice does not match consequence, independence, boundedness, or evidence-access needs.

failure_taxonomy.name: PRESERVATION_MISS
failure_taxonomy.definition: Material unresolved/new understanding is lost because no appropriate durable path was activated.

failure_taxonomy.name: PREMATURE_AUTHORITY_PROMOTION
failure_taxonomy.definition: Conversation/capture/candidate material is treated as accepted authority without explicit promotion.

failure_taxonomy.name: RESUME_TARGET_LOSS
failure_taxonomy.definition: Interruption/side work closes without a reconstructable parent objective/return target.

failure_taxonomy.name: RECOVERY_PATH_DEPENDENCY_FAILURE
failure_taxonomy.definition: The only available recovery instructions/path depend on the failed component.

failure_taxonomy.name: EVOLUTION_TRIGGER_MISS
failure_taxonomy.definition: A declared reopen/escalation condition is observed but does not activate evaluation.

failure_taxonomy.name: FROZEN_CONTRACT_DRIFT
failure_taxonomy.definition: Implementation/process diverges from frozen architecture without explicit clarification/amendment/supersession/reopen.

failure_taxonomy.name: OBLIGATION_REALIZATION_GAP
failure_taxonomy.definition: Accepted design/spec obligation is not connected to an implementation gate/evidence/operational realization path.

failure_taxonomy.name: GIT_LIFECYCLE_DRIFT
failure_taxonomy.definition: Branch/publication lifecycle state diverges from governed policy, including prolonged qualified unpublished accumulation.

failure_taxonomy.name: CONTROL_OBSERVABILITY_GAP
failure_taxonomy.definition: The system cannot explain what it activated/routed/left latent or why.

failure_taxonomy.name: BRIDGE_AUTHORITY_LEAK
failure_taxonomy.definition: Successor control-plane output is treated as successor semantic authority before explicit cutover.

failure_taxonomy.name: OWNER_REMINDER_DEPENDENCY
failure_taxonomy.definition: Correct project behavior occurs only after the owner remembers and names a mechanism/knowledge source that should have activated independently.

response_classes.FAIL_CLOSED: Do not perform the consequential action or authority transition.
response_classes.FAIL_VISIBLE_AND_RECONSTRUCT: Stop the affected continuation and reconstruct from durable project state.
response_classes.ROUTE_REPAIR: Correct process/collaboration routing before material continuation.
response_classes.ROUTE_REPAIR_AND_EVIDENCE: Correct the activation route and preserve the miss as qualification evidence when material.
response_classes.REPLAN_CONTEXT: Recompute a smaller/more appropriate reconstruction closure.
response_classes.EVIDENCE_AND_REVIEW_TRIGGER: Preserve observed trigger evidence and open the governed evaluation path; do not auto-change architecture.
response_classes.FAIL_VISIBLE_AND_CLASSIFY: Stop silent drift and classify as defect/clarification/amendment/supersession/reopen.
response_classes.SCHEDULE_RECONCILIATION: Create a prospective realization obligation; do not rewrite past acceptance history.
response_classes.BREAK_GLASS: Use an independent recovery path and preserve/resume parent workstream state.
response_classes.CAPTURE_OR_RECOVER: Preserve material unresolved reasoning through the least-authoritative sufficient path.
response_classes.ROUTE_REPAIR_OR_REVIEW: Correct collaborator/tool topology or open appropriate review.
response_classes.ROUTE_REPAIR_OR_WARN: Repair immediately if lifecycle integrity is at risk; otherwise surface bounded warning/obligation.
response_classes.EVIDENCE_REQUIRED: Do not claim qualified control behavior without inspectable traversal/routing evidence.
response_classes.EVIDENCE_AND_ROOT_CAUSE: Record the owner-reminder dependency and determine which activation/routing rule failed.
